# Core Text — The Drift Ledger

---

## Key Results

**Bounded drift (clm-drf024; [§2.4](sub2.4/index.md)).** The ledger's drift stays inside a fixed
band for every admissible schedule.

**Drift rate (clm-drf025; [§2.4](sub2.4/index.md)).** Inside the band the drift decays at a
geometric rate.
